description:
[x402 Paywall] Create a tenant account. Returns a Bearer apiKey ONCE — store it and set PAYWALL_API_KEY. Rate-limited to 5/hour per IP.

Use when you want a paywall tenant account and its API key (shown once). Not for managing routes of an existing tenant.

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.

slug.description: Lowercase a-z0-9 and hyphens, 2-40 chars; becomes your mount path prefix /{slug}.

name: paywall_signup
